name: Unending Torment

angles.text: For the Forsaken, subjugating reanimated remains to the Dark Lady's service through alchemical torment is standard practice in the Apothecarium's daily operations.
The Royal Apothecary Society continues to brew sinister concoctions deep beneath the ruins of Lordaeron, testing the limits of alchemical subjugation.
Procuring Blisterweed from the Apothecarium's herbalist trainers highlights the overlap between standard botanical study and the Society's darker alchemical projects.
The quest requires venturing into the Rogues' Quarter to purchase Essence of Agony, a potent reagent typically favored by poison crafters and assassins.

faq.answer: The quest is given by Master Apothecary Faranell, the leader of the Royal Apothecary Society, found in the Apothecarium within the Undercity.
faq.q: Who offers the quest Unending Torment?

faq.answer: Master Apothecary Faranell requires three specific ingredients: a Toxic Skullcap from Tawny Grisette in the Trade Quarter, Blisterweed from near the herbalism trainers in the Apothecarium, and Essence of Agony from a poison vendor in the Rogues' Quarter.
faq.q: What reagents are needed for Faranell's concoction?

aliases: who is the lost sheep faranell mentions
faq.answer: The recipient is an unwilling captive whose severed head has been freshly reattached. Faranell refers to him mockingly as a 'lost sheep' and an 'honored guest,' seeking to crush whatever defiant bravado he still clings to after suffering severe beatings.
faq.q: Who is Master Apothecary Faranell experimenting on?

faq.answer: The potion is formulated to mentally break the subject and forcibly bind it to the will of Lady Sylvanas Windrunner, the Dark Lady of the Forsaken. Faranell believes the creature's battered state makes it particularly susceptible to chemical domination.
faq.q: What is the goal of Faranell's potion?

faq.answer: Tawny Grisette is located in the Trade Quarter of the Undercity, where she supplies specialty goods including the Toxic Skullcap needed by the apothecaries.
faq.q: Where can players find Tawny Grisette?

faq.answer: Blisterweed is found near the Undercity's herbalism trainers, the Alliestars, who reside within the Apothecarium. Faranell mentions they owe him a favor, allowing adventurers to freely take what is needed.

sections.body: Deep within the Apothecarium of the Undercity, Master Apothecary Faranell oversees gruesome experiments aimed at bolstering the Forsaken's power. Having successfully reattached the severed head of a battered captive, Faranell requires a specialized alchemical mixture to crush what little resistance remains in the creature and permanently bind its will to Lady Sylvanas Windrunner.
sections.title: Binding the Will

sections.body: To prepare his subjugating brew, Faranell sends his agent across the Undercity to gather potent ingredients. The task involves obtaining a Toxic Skullcap from Tawny Grisette in the Trade Quarter, claiming Blisterweed from the nearby herbalist trainers who owe him a debt, and purchasing Essence of Agony from a poison vendor lurking in the Rogues' Quarter.
sections.title: Apothecary Reagents

sections.body: Upon receiving the ingredients, Faranell expresses grim satisfaction with his impending masterpiece. He relishes the prospect of testing his concoction against their 'honored guest,' confident that the agonizing draught will strip away the captive's remaining bravado and return the stray creature obediently to the Dark Lady's service.
sections.title: The Masterpiece

summary: Unending Torment is a quest in the Undercity where Master Apothecary Faranell seeks to bind a reassembled captive to the Dark Lady's will. To complete the subjugating concoction, adventurers must gather lethal reagents from across the Forsaken capital.
